quotes.author: Customer Service
quotes.text: Customer Service18:50 15 Jun 26Had an awesome time with MDQ Watersports! The staff was friendly, the service was great, and the jet skis were in perfect condition.Big thanks to Cristian and Sebastian for the photos and videos. The pictures came out amazing and were way better than we expected. They captured some really great moments on the water, and now we have awesome memories from our trip.Definitely recommend MDQ Watersports if you're looking for a fun jet ski experience and great photos to remember it by!

quotes.author: Regina Saldana
quotes.text: Regina Saldana13:25 06 Aug 255 stars! Probably wouldn’t go anywhere else. Tried a few other places. One, we showed up early, with confirmation email, having paid a deposit of $65–only to be turned away. This guy answered all my questions and even called me to make sure I was making my reservation. Also I fell off the back of the jetski, and although I was fine and able to climb back on independently, the employee got there super fast to check on me!! Nothing but good things to say about these guys.

quotes.author: Dasha prylypko
quotes.text: Dasha prylypko19:28 31 May 25Great price for jetskies, I had fun!!! You get to ride freely in the ocean to a certain areas. You can buy an amazing video that is filmed by a drone, very professional it is 60$ which is not too bad. Once again bad so much fun, everyone was helpful and the instructions were given clearly. There is a public parking right in front of the beach if you need it is 1$ per hour so it’s easy to get there if you’re with a car.

quotes.author: Diamalee Candelaria
quotes.text: Diamalee Candelaria08:26 22 Nov 25This place is a scam!! I payed a lot of $ for an hour and they kicked me off less than 30 mins. The instructor did not tell me I was not supposed to pass a certain location and then kicked me off for passing it and I told them well nobody told me beforehand or I obviously wouldn’t have done it so I paid a lot of money 400 hundreds dollars to be kicked off on my birthday. DO NOT GO HERE THEY STEAL YOUR MONEY

quotes.author: Lesly Deleon
quotes.text: Lesly Deleon02:58 19 Feb 26This was hands down one of the best experiences I’ve had! From check-in to the ride, everything was smooth and professional. The guide explained safety clearly and showed us how to maneuver the jet ski before we started. Once we were out on the water, it was pure adrenaline and so much fun! I felt safe the entire time and still got to enjoy the thrill. Highly recommend to anyone looking for a fun activity!

quotes.author: Gaylene Horsfall
quotes.text: Gaylene Horsfall22:50 30 Aug 25Very blunt and to the point. We were shocked to hear the restrictions that it was only half a mile north to south jet skiing, and a half a mile from the beach. If you want freedom to tour where you want, you are in for a big shock.They take photos and à video of your time from a drone. Really good. It will cost you $60 though.
